widgets_values:
No negative prompt on H3

H3 runs at CFG 1: the sampler reads the positive only, a negative
has nothing to push against.

NAG cannot help either. It guides inside a CROSS-attention, and H3
has none -- text, video and audio run as one joint sequence. The
Polyhedron NAG node refuses H3 and says so in the console, so this
template has no NAG node.

To keep something out of the picture, describe what you DO want.

nodes.title: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS
widgets_values: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS -- first -> last frame: she sits down

FIRST -> LAST FRAME -- A) she stands, B) she has sat down on the chair
Keyframes and pose video from the Pexels clip 11066122 (portrait, Pexels licence); the files are in
assets/flf_sitdown/, the original clip beside them (see docs/third_party/flf_sitdown_media.md).

- One shot, 4.46 s (107 frames). The official FL2VA rule: describe the WAY, not the two pictures --
  first-frame state -> visible intermediate changes -> narrowing difference -> last-frame state.
- The pair decides: B is made FROM A (same camera, light, background) -- else the model has no common
  ground and fades A into B (a dissolve).
- Transition Check (group 8) after the decode: the pair, then MOTION / DISSOLVE / SNAP for the clip,
  and how close the clip's ends came to A and B.
- Seed FIXED as in the run shown in the README (assets/flf_sitdown_run.mp4).

THE CONTROL: first + last frame + pose, depth and canny from ONE video, blended to ONE control.
IN: Media Loader 'pose video' (2a) -> Control Fit (length, size, 24 fps).
MAP: Control Map pose (2a), depth (2c), canny (2d) read the same fitted frames; each shows its
  frames in the node and is saved as a video; the pose save writes the keypoints JSON.
BLEND (2e): depth as the base, pose and canny over it, black = clear -> ONE control,
  saved too -> ONE Apply Control (5d, 0.9 until 60 %). 2f (bypassed): reuse a saved control video.
Models: a missing one turns its node's line orange -- Download (sha256-checked).
Preview: the light WAN TAE (lighttaew2_1) on every sampler.

widgets_values_named.title: HOW THIS WORKFLOW RUNS -- first -> last frame E
widgets_values_named.text:
FIRST -> LAST FRAME -- A) she stands, B) she has sat down on the chair
Keyframes and pose from the Pexels clip 11066122 (portrait 768x1344, free licence).

- One shot, 4.46 s (107 frames). The official FL2VA rule: describe the WAY, not the two pictures --
  first-frame state -> visible intermediate changes -> narrowing difference -> last-frame state.
- The pair decides: make B FROM A (same camera, light, background; an image edit of A), else the model
  has no common ground and fades A into B (a dissolve).
- Transition Check (group 8) after the decode: the pair, then MOTION / DISSOLVE / SNAP for the clip,
  and how close the clip's ends came to A and B. Its thresholds are rules of thumb until we have renders.
- Seed FIXED (2094697665): A, B and C render the same noise -- compare them.
- Saves: today's folder, PH_<time>_FLF_SIT_D_...; the clip lands on the timeline's track (flf_sit).

THIS VARIANT -- D: first + last frame + pose, depth and canny from one video, blended to ONE control.
IN: Media Loader 'pose video' (2a, a video or one image) -> Control Fit (length, size, 24 fps).
MAP: Control Map pose (2a), depth (2c), canny (2d) read the same fitted frames; each shows its
  frames in the node and is saved as a video (templates); the pose save writes the keypoints JSON.
BLEND (2e): depth as the base, pose (1.0) and canny (0.6) over it, black = clear -> ONE control,
  saved too -> ONE Apply Control (5d, 0.8 until 60 %). 2f (bypassed): reuse a saved control video.
flf_pose_sitdown_x1.mp4 = the real speed: 0.6 s standing, 2.0 s sitting down, 1.8 s seated.

E = D + the findings of run D (23.10.):
- D measured: MOTION (residual 0.43, the real clip 0.45), both keyframes hit (29 dB), no jumps.
  Timing: half of the way at 1.17 s (real clip 1.38 s), 90 % at 3.71 s (real 4.17 s) -- a little early.
- Apply Control 0.8 -> 0.9: the blended control holds the real timing tighter.
- Canny now 'difference' in the Blend: white lines stay visible on the bright depth map.
- The control maps show their frames in the Saves (running preview, autoplay on);
  the maps and the Blend no longer render their own previews (lighter UI).
- The clip comes out ~3 % darker than the keyframes (a decode shift, not the pose).

nodes.title: REUSE
widgets_values:
REUSE A SAVED CONTROL VIDEO
A pose, depth, canny or blended video saved in 2b-2e
IS a control already: Media Loader -> Control Fit ->
Apply Control 'control', no Control Map in between.

To use: put the file into input, pick it in the loader,
un-bypass the three nodes of 2f (loader, fit, the
second Apply Control) and bypass the first Apply
Control -- or keep both and lower the strengths so
the sum stays near 1.
